tasks.title: Announcement #12
tasks.instruction: Listen to a teacher talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript:
It's that time of year again and the Talent Show process is in full swing!
Every year, students show off their amazing talents making it one of the most popular events in the school. Auditions will be taking place next week. Sign-ups are up until Wednesday, but do not wait until the last minute, as we used to receive a lot of complaints about failing to sign up. So hurry up and contact your teacher about the event.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To ask students to help organize the talent show.
options.B: To ask whether students interested in taking part in the talent show.
options.C: To inform about an activity of school.
options.D: To tell students to come to her to sign up for audition for talent show.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段通知的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住老师整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 老师鼓励学生报名参加才艺展示，而非请他们帮忙组织活动，属于概念混淆。 选项B：错误。 老师明确告知学生才艺展示正在进行、试镜将在下周举行，并催促报名，并非只是询问学生是否感兴趣。 选项C：正确。 老师告知了才艺展示这一学校活动的时间安排（试镜下周）、报名截止日期（周三）以及报名方式（联系老师），整段话的目的是通知学生关于这项活动的信息。 选项D：错误。 老师让学生联系自己的老师报名，而非直接来找她报名，属于细节错误。

questions.stem: What can we infer about the show?

options.A: It was not popular last year.
options.B: Few students like to attend it.
options.C: It has always been very popular.
options.D: This is the event's first year.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于才艺展示可以推断出什么，属于推理判断题，需抓住老师对活动的描述进行推断。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 老师明确说这是“one of the most popular events in the school”，说明去年（及往年）也应该很受欢迎，而非不流行。 选项B：错误。 老师提到这是学校最受欢迎的活动之一，说明很多学生喜欢参加，而非很少。 选项C：正确。 老师说“Every year, students show off their amazing talents making it one of the most popular events”，说明这项活动一直以来都很受欢迎。 选项D：错误。 老师说“It's that time of year again”以及“Every year”，说明这不是第一年举办，而是年度活动。
